lessons.goal: 複習同意範圍、解讀與時間餘裕，找出關鍵條件。

questions.evidence: Jin's review sheet uses five words from the week: public, interpretations, transcript, margin, and condition. A large sentence appears at the top of each card, while a smaller line below it adds information. Jin must read both before deciding what action is reasonable.
questions.explanation: 任務要求兩部分都讀後再判斷。
options: The large sentence if it sounds true.
Only the first word.
Both the large sentence and the smaller line.
Only the heading.
questions.prompt: What must Jin read on each card?

questions.evidence: One card says a group approved a photograph. The smaller line says approval was for a private chat. Jin rejects a plan to post it publicly. Another card describes a boy as nervous; its lower line reveals that viewers heard an exam story before watching.
questions.explanation: 同意範圍僅限私人群組，不能延伸為公開。
options: The picture had no people.
The approval covered only a private chat.
Public photographs are always forbidden.
The group refused every kind of sharing.
questions.prompt: Why does Jin reject public posting?

questions.evidence: A walking-tour card says the route takes thirty minutes. Below it, the borrower arrives at 4:15, must return a player at 4:45, and wants a ten-minute margin. Jin explains that finishing on time would still fail that preference.
options: Ten minutes.
Thirty minutes.
None.
Fifteen minutes.
questions.prompt: How much margin remains after a thirty-minute route starting at 4:15 with a 4:45 deadline?

questions.evidence: For a visitor who wants the stories without audio, Jin selects a transcript. He notices that the smaller lines are not always unimportant details. A condition can change which answer is best, even when the largest sentence on the page remains completely true.
questions.explanation: 想讀故事而不聽時使用的文字版本。
options: A private photograph collection.
A rule about returning equipment.
A written version of spoken content.
A longer route through the street.

questions.evidence: One card says a group approved a photograph. The smaller line says approval was for a private chat. Jin rejects a plan to post it publicly. Another card describes a boy as nervous; its lower line reveals that viewers heard an exam story before watching.
questions.explanation: 先給考試背景可能影響觀眾對表情的判斷。
options: It may have influenced the viewers' interpretation.
It changes the length of the silent clip.
It shows all viewers had identical reactions.
It proves the actor received a real exam result.
questions.prompt: Why does the exam introduction matter to the nervous-boy description?
